expected.verdict: Long-term resolution: LISA (~2041) can close the 2,200 M☉ gap at 3.0σ via emri signal detection in the mhz band.
Near-term resolution: Gaia DR4 (~2028) can close the 2,200 M☉ gap at 3.0σ via proper-motion dispersion profile.

_derivation_note: Hand-derived from the page's own estimateDetection()/buildVerdictDF() closed-form scaling law (no Monte Carlo). requiredMassRes = gap/(2*sigma) for scenario='current' (= 2200/6 = 366.667 M_sun), or lower/sigma for 'rule_out' (= 8200/3 = 2733.33 M_sun). Each instrument (gaia-dr4 mass_res=3500/launch=2026/lag=1, roman 1800/2027/2, elt-micado 1200/2028/3, lisa 500/2037/2) is capable outright if mass_res<=requiredMassRes (year=launch+lag), else extraYears=ceil(lag*((mass_res/requiredMassRes)^2-1)) capped at 15, capable iff extraYears<=10. Arithmetic verified independently in Node (fractions: 366.667=1100/3, 2733.33=8200/3) reproducing exactly {2042,2044,2046,2041} and {2028,2029,2031,2039} above -- see OCS-FIXWAVE.md FW-4 board note for the session transcript.
